name: ruMT-Bench
description:
ruMT-Bench
	

ruMT-Bench contains instructive multi-turn questions divided into 8 different areas of knowledge (writing, roleplay, extraction, reasoning, math, coding, STEM, humanities/social science). GPT-4 scores models' responses on a scale of 1 to 10. The final score is determined by the average of the entire conversation. For some complex problems that require a precise answer (e.g. math and coding), a reference answer is included in the judge's prompt to help evaluate responses… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/NLPCoreTeam/ruMT-Bench.
reputation: A purpose-built Russian multi-turn evaluation set used by NLPCoreTeam and others to benchmark Russian-capable chat models; growing adoption in Russian-language model evaluation.
